comments.value: I'm not sure how the system works but if there's a tiling setting for the texture being projected, setting the X value to -1 might just do the trick.
I think you could at least flip the sticker based on which hand you use to place it. No UI changes needed in that case.

Oh, so this request has been around for a while. I was thinking the same thing the other day. I found this page so I'm leaving a comment. The sticker feature is really fun, and some stickers become even more interesting when combined with stickers placed by other users. For example, hand stickers. However, if you save the left and right variations every time, all 18 slots will always be filled. This is useful in terms of reducing the number of slots.

yes, it would also be helpful to be able to rotate with the thumbstick maybe, so if you wanna place one upside down on the floor for a friend to read, you dont gotta turn your entire hand upside down. On desktop, the same buttons used to rotate held objects would also work.

details: When placing a sticker it would be great to be able to flip the sticker horizontally to "mirror" it instead of having to upload 2 variants of the same image. The same could go for vertical mirror although the user could just turn their controller.
title: [1515] Stickers: Add ability to flip stickers horizontally/vertically before placing
